comment: Read from src/LFO.cpp and src/blocks/LFOBlock.hpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The reset is a step detector rather than a threshold: LFOBlock.hpp:100 compares the jack against its own value half a volt earlier, so only a jump of more than 0.5V between two samples restarts the cycle. The Reset button adds 1 to the same value, which is how pressing it works. The amplitude knob reaches 5 while the total with the jack is clamped at 10, so a jack alone can drive the output twice as far as the knob. The eight shape names are at LFOBlock.hpp:34 to 43.
